pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet / Chamfer Tool for QGIS 3.x
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet and Chamfer editing tool like in QGIS 4, compatible with QGIS 3.16–3.99.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Brings the native QGIS 4.0 interactive Fillet (corner rounding) and Chamfer (corner beveling) CAD digitizing tool to QGIS 3.x (3.16–3.99). Features real-time on-canvas CAD HUD widget, mouse hover preview, vertex snapping, segment locks, and batch processing for selected vector features.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, geometry, digitizing, curve
